digest.component_or_area: tickets repository migration and epoch enforcement
propositions: A force-push rewrite of the tickets repository must execute only after all writers are quiesced, all in-flight workflows disabled, zero active sessions confirmed, and all MCP servers stopped
Pre-publication correctness assertions (tree hash, commit/merge counts, identity verification, ancestry, pack size) must run on an unfiltered scratch clone before the force-with-lease push to origin

The epoch-mismatch guard at identity.enforce_since must be re-pinned through Gerrit after the rewrite, with the first post-window write deterministically measured and old-tip ancestry verified as false
Post-rewrite reconciliation (dry-run, live Jira mutations, state persistence, canary drift check, and fsck clean) must complete successfully before the quiet window closes and sessions resume

Rollback capability requires the A6-0d bundle and reverse force-with-lease to the old tip, with the caveat that any already-converged consumers must be re-converged in the same order as the forward path
